card.name: Which after C. difficile toxins A and B
card.fires_on: The word "which" (or "they") right after a noun phrase, mainly in the C. difficile warning sentence "produces toxins A and B which contribute to CDAD". It also fires on a relative pronoun starting a clause about harm caused.

modes.label: C. difficile toxin sentence
modes.description: "which" after "toxins A and B", introducing a clause about CDAD.
modes.example: C. difficile produces toxins A and B<< which>> contribute to the development of CDAD.

modes.label: Pronoun giving a reason
modes.description: "they" after "since", introducing a clause about problems linked to a product.
